name: r7-icu-lifecycle-collation
description: Locale/Intl parity (task-icu-parity): push.js lifecycleBindingTx sorts the retired and live schedule lists with String.prototype.localeCompare. The gateway's Node 20.18.3 (small ICU 75.1) collates with the CLDR 45 root order, which golang.org/x/text/collate (CLDR 23, Unicode 6.2) does not reproduce: Han in radical-stroke order (U+20004 before U+4E23), an emoji added after Unicode 6.2 (U+1FAE8, a symbol, before letters), Arabic-Indic digit one before superscript one, and canonically equivalent mark orders that compare equal (the stable sort keeps the SQL order). edge/vectors/intl-gateway.vectors.json records the gateway's order.
